verdict.rationale: Tavily offers one API with Search, Extract (batch up to 20 URLs), and a Research endpoint. Research 'performs comprehensive research on a given topic by conducting multiple searches, analyzing sources, and generating a detailed research report', with mini/pro modes, streaming, and async retrieval by request ID. All of these tools are also exposed through one official MCP server for agents, and a community user reports having agents use Tavily for deep-research-style work. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the Research endpoint's extraction depth and synthesis quality (e.g., source citations in reports are not evidenced).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent run a multi-step research flow — search, extract contents, and synthesize — through one API

citations.quote: Tavily Research performs comprehensive research on a given topic by conducting multiple searches, analyzing sources, and generating a detailed research report.
Extract content from one URL or batch up to 20 URLs in one request.
Execute a search query using Tavily Search.
Connect Tavily's search, extract, crawl, map, and research tools to Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor, Kiro, VS Code, or any MCP client.
Retrieve the status and results of a research task using its request ID.
